title: Make Rust test wrapper resolve Cargo in non-login WSL
outcome: On Windows, invoking  ash scripts/test-rust.sh from PowerShell enters non-login WSL where Cargo is absent from PATH, so the required review gate fails at line 60 with xec: cargo: not found even though native Cargo is installed and login WSL resolves /home/greg/.cargo/bin/cargo. Document/use a login-shell invocation or make the wrapper resolve the standard Cargo location without depending on interactive profile setup. Evidence: fd soft limit=10240, test threads=4, then cargo not found.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 2, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-OBSOLETE. The gate never enters WSL; it uses Git for Windows bash by explicit path (scripts/test-launcher.mjs:150-159).
